lina_partners: Quick note 10 - partner ask: need a secure signing / provenance pattern for Terraform modules we publish to marketplace. want to show partners how to sign releases and add CI checks that validate signatures before publish. thoughts?

paul_partner: strongly +1. our compliance team requires attestations for any external modules. examples of sigstore or GPG workflows would help.

tom_eng: we can demo sigstore/cosign for module artifacts (tgz) and an Action that verifies signature before tagging. simpler than GPG for partners.

reza_infra: i'll add a GH Action that does: build module bundle -> cosign sign -> upload release asset. and a validate job that runs on marketplace ingestion to verify signatures.

maya_docs: i'll add a short section in the quickstart: "module provenance" with commands, example outputs, and a troubleshooting note for missing keys.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace policy update: signature validation recommended for partner modules; unsigned modules allowed but flagged in UI. (system)

paul_partner: can you include a sample snippet for verify in CI? we want our pipeline to fail fast if signature missing.

tom_eng: snippet we can show in session:
```yaml
name: verify-signature
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Install cosign
        run: curl -sSLf https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/latest/download/cosign-linux-amd64 -o cosign && chmod +x cosign && sudo mv cosign /usr/local/bin/
      - name: Verify artifact signature
        run: cosign verify-blob --key ${COSIGN_PUB_KEY} module.tgz.sig module.tgz
```

lina_partners: love it. scope for the partner workshop: quickstart + module signing appendix + action templates. deliverable: repo with signed-sample tag and a validation Action. can we ship Friday?

reza_infra: yes. i'll provision a sample key pair and CI secrets in the demo org. will also include notes for partners who prefer HSM/KMS-backed keys.

maya_docs: i'll draft the doc and add a short diagram showing the signing flow and where marketplace validation hooks in.

lina_partners: great 10. i'll loop in marketplace product to consider UI flagging language. we'll reconvene Thu to validate demo assets. :white_check_mark:
